H1.evidence: First support rung orients without giving the decisive answer.

H2.evidence: Later support adds one bridge at a time and remains method-level.

H3.evidence: Complete working remains post-attempt in the governed solution reveal.

S1.evidence: A Core2 pre-attempt diagram would be decorative or would disclose a requested decision; the reusable representation is taught on a changed case in Core1A.

S2.evidence: The source item can be attempted symbolically; changed-case teaching carries the useful representation.

S3.evidence: No decorative source figure is substituted for the learner's requested construction.

P1.evidence: Answer was independently solved from the exact supplied givens and conditions.

P2.evidence: An expansion, substitution, exact-sign or structural second check is recorded.

P3.evidence: Degree/domain/exception conditions are explicit; finite samples are not used as identity proof.

M1.evidence: A concrete tempting wrong route is recorded.

M2.evidence: A changed-case prediction-and-reason probe is used after attempted work; it does not certify mastery.

M3.evidence: Repair states a replacement rule and a fresh transfer application.
